verdict.rationale: Atlassian's features page explicitly advertises customizable fields and workflows ([jira-docs-3], [jira-docs-13]), configurable at both global and project level ([jira-docs-16]), with customizable project templates ([jira-docs-5]). A community user confirms 'a good amount of customization' ([jira-comm-1]). Criticism of Jira's transition model ([jira-comm-3]) is a complaint about workflow design, not evidence that customization fails, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation on custom field types and on defining custom workflow statuses and transitions, plus independent hands-on corroboration that a PM (rather than an admin) can make these changes.
